claims.statement: The Met gives Mithridates I’s reign as approximately 171–138 BCE.

evidence.note: Reign dates, not a lifespan. The source describes expansion under this ruler and his successors collectively; individual campaigns are not dated here.

sources.title: The Parthian Empire (247 BCE–224 CE)
sources.creator: Blair Fowlkes-Childs and Department of Ancient Near Eastern Art, The Metropolitan Museum of Art
